content:
Avery (CS): Hey team — kicking off HelioSync onboarding. Quick sync: timeline, owners, success metrics, and any renewal risks flagged. Customer contact: Sofia (Head of ML)
Jordan (PM): Thanks! Proposed 6-week plan: W0 discovery, W1 integration, W2 pilot data, W3 perf tuning, W4 UAT, W5 go-live + hypercare. Can we confirm availability? I'll spin up a JIRA board and invite owners.
Sofia - HelioSync: Thanks everyone. Heads-up: our SRE leads are OOO next Tue/Wed. Primary goals for pilot: <10% latency regressions vs baseline, >=99.5% inference uptime. Renewal concern: procurement review in ~10 months — need ROI story by month 6.
Ravi (Solutions): Noted. I'll instrument KPIs: p99 latency, avg latency, tokens/sec, error rate, cost per 1M tokens. I'll own dashboard + alert thresholds.
Mira (CS Ops): I'll schedule weekly 30m check-ins (Mon 11:00am PT) and capture qualitative feedback in the onboarding form. Anyone prefer different cadence?
Sofia - HelioSync: :thumbsup: Mon 11am PT works. For enablement we need: 60-min dev workshop (devs + SRE), and a 1-pager for procurement/legal describing data paths.
Avery (CS): Assigning owners: integration = Jordan; infra/perf = Ravi; success metrics & ROI = Mira; legal/data = Priya. I'll be overall CS owner.
Priya (Security): I'll prepare data-flow diagram, KMS integration plan, and EU data residency notes. ETA: EOD Thu.
OnboardBot: New onboarding created: helio-sync/heliosync — ticket #ORS-1187 (automated).
Jordan (PM): One ask — can we get a 24hr anonymized production trace by next Wed? That will help perf tuning and KV cache patterns. Sofia?
Sofia - HelioSync: We can provide a 24h anonymized trace by Tue. We will need an NDA addendum for traces that include request metadata.
Mira (CS Ops): I'll draft the addendum today and route for signature. Also proposing a 50-item prompt eval set for quality checks during pilot — volunteers to help curate?
Ravi (Solutions): I'll run quantization A/Bs: start with 4-bit baseline and fallback to 8-bit for safety. We'll measure cost delta vs p99 impact.
Sofia - HelioSync: Agreed on A/B plan. Escalation path: ping me + CTO (Raj) if go-live risks surface.
Avery (CS): Capturing initial risks: procurement timeline, NDA for traces, EU data residency, potential SRE availability gaps. Add anything else here.
Sofia - HelioSync: Add renewal signal requirement: client expects to see either >=20% reduction in inference cost or >=15% throughput improvement within first 90 days — otherwise renewal will be reevaluated. Recording for transparency.
Mira (CS Ops): Got it — I'll add that to the success-criteria doc and link in the project board.
Jordan (PM): I'll post the project board by EOD and tag owners with milestone dates.
Priya (Security): Quick note — for KMS we need customer KMS details; Sofia can you share contact for your SecOps?
Sofia - HelioSync: I'll DM the SecOps contact (Elena) and loop Priya.
Avery (CS): Next steps recap: Priya KMS/data-flow doc due Thu EOD; Mira addendum + prompt eval by EOD today; Sofia to deliver trace Tue; Jordan to publish board EOD; weekly sync Mon 11am PT starting next week. Anything else?
Sofia - HelioSync: Nothing else from me. Looking forward to the workshop.
Mira (CS Ops): Thanks all — I’ll send calendar invites and the onboarding intake doc after this thread. :rocket:
